BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, élenxis is the word for rebuke. In 2 Peter 2:16, the text says "But was rebuked for his iniquity."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, élenxis, does its job quietly — rebuke — and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
